quests.name: Bread for the Night Boats
quests.text: Silas promised the night boats bread from Esther's oven again. Help Naomi keep an old fisherman's word.
quests.done: Silas: "Little loaf, the whole dock smells like your Savta's mornings again."

quests.name: A Table at Amos's House
quests.text: The believers have stopped meeting while Elder Amos lies ill. Naomi wants a table set so no one eats alone.
quests.done: The benches are full again. Someone starts a psalm, and nobody whispers.

quests.name: Feed the Dock Menders
quests.text: The fishermen are mending the rotten docks plank by plank. Naomi means to feed every one of them, grumblers included.
quests.done: Silas: "Full bellies swing hammers straighter. That reminds me of the year... ah, later."

quests.name: Furnish Simon's Guest Room
quests.text: Simon the tanner is expecting a guest, and his house by the sea is bare. Naomi offers to help make it welcoming.
quests.done: The room smells of fresh bread instead of the tanning yard. Simon cannot stop smiling.

quests.name: Ready the New Meeting House
quests.text: The believers have outgrown Elder Amos's home, and a new house is rising. He asks Naomi to help make it ready.
quests.done: Amos: "Well now. I forget most things these days, but not this. Not this."

quests.name: Light for the Watchtower
quests.text: The harbor watchtower has stood dark for two years. Naomi is gathering what its keepers will need for the long nights.
quests.done: Silas: "Now, that reminds me of... no. No story tonight, little loaf. Only thank you."

text.title: Order Quests
text.intro: Big requests from the town. Give what you can, when you can.
text.locked: Finish the chapter before this one to open it.
